ngne01.title: Aries vs Libra: Fastest Buzzer Loses
ngne01.caption:
Aries buzzed before the question existed. Libra needed a minute to pick a flag. Somehow it ended in a tie, and the front row is still crying.
Who are you on game night: the buzzer or the ponderer?

ngne02.title: Leo vs Sagittarius: Zero Inside Voices
ngne02.caption:
Two fire signs, one stage, zero volume control. Sag won on honesty, and Leo still led the standing ovation.
Which fire sign do you want in your corner after a breakup?

ngne03.title: Taurus vs Scorpio: The Staring Round
ngne03.caption:
Nobody blinked, nobody buzzed, and the host had to ask twice. Then Scorpio opened the vault, just a little.
Tag the friend who keeps every secret forever.

ngne04.title: Virgo vs Capricorn: Clipboards Out
ngne04.caption:
Two clipboards walked onto a game show. Virgo won by forgiving a forgotten coffee order, and Capricorn handed over a gold star like a true professional.
What's your coffee order, and does your person know it?

ngne05.title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: Yes or Yes
ngne05.caption:
"Yes or yes?" is not a question, Sagittarius. Gemini took the round by asking about the homebody's favorite night in.
Are you the plan-maker or the plan-joiner?

ngne06.title: Aries vs Leo: The Main Event
ngne06.caption:
Aries changed its mind mid-argument on live TV. Leo threw a party for someone else. Character growth all around, and the scoreboard split it down the middle.
Who needs the bigger stage in your friend group?

ngne07.title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Soup or Steps
ngne07.caption:
One sign brings soup, one brings a five-step plan. Capricorn won by saying "I missed you" out loud, then blushed.
Soup person or plan person: which do you need on a bad day?

ngne08.title: Taurus vs Virgo: Snack Diplomacy
ngne08.caption:
Taurus showed up eating. Virgo walked into a messy apartment and did not clean it, which deserves its own trophy.
Be honest: would you have cleaned it?

ngne09.title: Leo vs Aquarius: Center Stage
ngne09.caption:
Leo gave up the floor, Aquarius brought a homemade spotlight, and weird friends were declared the best kind.
Which friend in your group is the delightful kind of weird?

ngne10.title: Taurus vs Capricorn: No Rush
ngne10.caption:
The slowest round in Game Night history, with tea. Capricorn said "no rush" and let go of the fancy dinner plan, and nobody saw it coming.
Takeout night or fancy dinner, which one says love to you?

ngne11.title: Virgo vs Pisces: Tissues Provided
ngne11.caption:
Pisces was crying before the first question, so Virgo brought tissues and a spare stain pen. It ended in a tie, and yes, Virgo shed one tear.
Who's your stain pen friend?

ngne12.title: Aries vs Sagittarius: Before the Host
ngne12.caption:
Both buzzed before the host even made it on stage. Sag won by letting the other person pick, and Aries learned to walk a little slower.
Are you the one who races ahead or the one who waits?
